question: Based on our customer pizza order information, summarize the total quantity of each ingredient used in the pizzas we delivered. Output the name and quantity for each ingredient.
sql:
SELECT pt.topping_name, COUNT(*) as quantity
FROM (
    SELECT po.order_id, po.pizza_id, CAST(TRIM(regexp_split_to_table(pr.toppings, ',')) AS INTEGER) as topping_id
    FROM pizza_customer_orders po
    JOIN pizza_runner_orders ro ON po.order_id = ro.order_id
    JOIN pizza_recipes pr ON po.pizza_id = pr.pizza_id
    WHERE ro.cancellation IS NULL OR ro.cancellation = ''
) as exploded
JOIN pizza_toppings pt ON exploded.topping_id = pt.topping_id
GROUP BY pt.topping_name
ORDER BY quantity DESC
